name: CENNETIC M5-5 High-Rigidity 5-Axis Machining Center
summary: The M5-5 is a high-rigidity 5-axis machining center that adds continuous rotary axes to a vertical machining platform, delivering complex-contour capability without leaving the machine.
body:
The M5-5 is a high-rigidity 5-axis machining center that adds continuous rotary axes to a vertical machining platform, delivering complex-contour capability without leaving the machine.

About this model

This 5-Axis Machining Center is manufactured by our partner factory in Dongguan, China, and supplied direct by CENNETIC with factory-direct pricing, a standard warranty and remote setup support. Specifications are representative and can be confirmed against your machining requirements before order.
